mapper.select: select count(distinct o.id) from merchant_chapter_offer o join cms_topic t on t.id = o.topic_id and t.product_type = 2 and t.del_flag = 0 join mms_merchant mm on mm.member_id = o.merchant_id and mm.status = 1 and (mm.account_status is null or mm.account_status != 2) and (mm.del_flag is null or mm.del_flag != 2) where o.topic_id = #{topicId} and o.merchant_id = #{merchantMemberId} and o.status = 1 and (o.valid_end is null or o.valid_end > now())

select r.id registration_id, r.member_id, r.registration_no ticket_no, t.start_time ticket_start, t.end_time ticket_end, r.real_name, m.nickname, m.avatar, r.phone, case when min(rd.create_time) is null then 'ARRIVED' else 'REDEEMED' end entitlement_status, min(p.checkin_time) checkin_at, min(rd.create_time) service_started_at from merchant_chapter_offer o join mms_merchant mm on mm.member_id = o.merchant_id and mm.status = 1 and (mm.account_status is null or mm.account_status != 2) and (mm.del_flag is null or mm.del_flag != 2) join registration_entitlement e on e.topic_id = o.topic_id and e.chapter_id = o.chapter_id and e.status in (0, 1) join cms_registration r on r.id = e.registration_id and r.owner_type = 2 and r.purchase_kind = 3 and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and a.topic_id = o.topic_id join oms_ticket t on t.id = r.ticket_id and t.owner_type = 2 and t.owner_id = a.id and t.del_flag = 0 left join ums_member m on m.id = r.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 left join cms_topic_node n on n.topic_id = o.topic_id and n.chapter_id = o.chapter_id and n.merchant_member_id = o.merchant_id left join player_node_progress p on p.member_id = r.member_id and p.activity_id = r.owner_id and p.topic_id = o.topic_id and p.node_id = n.id and p.checkin_time is not null and p.del_flag = 0 left join redemption rd on rd.registration_id = r.id and rd.topic_id = o.topic_id and rd.chapter_id = o.chapter_id and rd.merchant_id = o.merchant_id and rd.status = 'ACTIVE' where o.topic_id = #{topicId} and o.merchant_id = #{merchantMemberId} and o.status = 1 and (o.valid_end is null or o.valid_end > now()) and (p.id is not null or rd.id is not null) group by r.id, r.member_id, r.registration_no, t.start_time, t.end_time, r.real_name, m.nickname, m.avatar, r.phone order by coalesce(min(rd.create_time), min(p.checkin_time)) desc, r.id desc
